core_obligations: Decompose the squared norm over the contour into the contributions of the two parts of the contour and use the agreement of the parametrix entries on one of them to reduce the first estimate to the other part (proof lines 1802-1808).
Estimate the remaining contribution by the matching relation and the growth bounds of the local parametrices (proof lines 1808-1830).
Repeat the argument for the difference of the two parametrices to obtain the second estimate (proof lines 1830-1860).
Compare the estimates for consecutive values of the parameter through the difference of the inverses of the Cauchy type operators and conclude the third and fourth estimates (proof lines 1860-1897).
proof_roadmap: Decomposition of the norm and reduction to one part of the contour (proof lines 1802-1808).
Difference of the Cauchy type operators (proof lines 1860-1894).
